You are an independent editor comparing two Russian translations of the same English source. You wrote neither of them.

SOURCE (English):
Mr Dursley was the director of a firm called Grunnings, which made drills. The Dursleys had everything they wanted, but they also had a secret. Mrs Potter was Mrs Dursley's sister, and they had not met for several years.

VERSION A:
Мистер Дурсли был директором фирмы Grunnings, которая делала свёрла.

VERSION B:
Мистер Дурсль был директором фирмы «Граннингс», которая выпускала дрели.

Answer two separate questions. They can have different answers, and often do.

1. ACCURACY: which version conveys the source more faithfully — nothing changed, nothing left out, nothing invented?
2. READABILITY: which version reads better as Russian prose?

Respond with EXACTLY two lines and nothing else:
ACCURACY: A|B|TIE
READABILITY: A|B|TIE
